notes: Normalized, validated and expanded symbol map. Added widely-used internet symbols (emoji + ASCII) with stable UIDs, ascii fallbacks, locales (en), tags, codepoints when available, and a lightweight search index. Removed malformed fragments, normalized arrays and objects, and added metadata to support CI checks.

metadata.notes: Run CI tasks to validate alias uniqueness, compute integrity.sha256_hex after canonicalization and update total_entries accordingly.

sym_0010_photon.description: Photon — quantum of electromagnetic radiation; used as idea/light metaphor.

sym_0020_higgs.description: Higgs boson — mass-giving field quantum; brain glyph used metaphorically.

trait_compassion.description: Compassion — caring response and warmth without judgment.

trait_validation.description: Validation — acknowledges feelings as real and important.

trait_curiosity.description: Curiosity — seeks to understand without assuming.

trait_boundaries.description: Boundaries — protects emotional energy and personal limits.

trait_resilience.description: Resilience — the capacity to recover from difficulties.

trait_trust.description: Trust — reliability and safety in relationships or systems.

emotion_ache.description: Ache — lingering emotional soreness and attachment.

emotion_grief.description: Grief — deep loss that reshapes the heart.

emotion_anger.description: Anger — high-intensity emotional response to perceived harm or injustice.

meta_release.description: Release — letting go of emotional weight.

social_heart.description: Social heart — like/favorite indicator used widely on social platforms.

social_reply.description: Reply arrow — respond to a message or thread.

misc_crown.description: Crown — leadership, top ranking, or premium status.

ascii_exclaim.description: Exclamation — emphasis, urgency, surprise, or excitement.

ascii_question.description: Question mark — inquiry, curiosity, or uncertainty.

ascii_hash.description: Hash — topic/tag marker; grouping or emphasis in social contexts.

ascii_star.description: Asterisk — emphasis, footnote; used as a marker for importance or censoring.

ascii_plus.description: Plus — addition, positive sign, accumulation, or affirmation.

ascii_dash.description: Dash/Minus — separation, subtraction, or negative tone.

ascii_tilde.description: Tilde — approximation, casual tone, informal equivalence.
